text.title: Herring Gull
text.menu_sub: Soar over the sea and rest on rocks.
text.menu_wild: Stay with the group near the water.
text.intro: Walk and run on the shore. Hold Fly to lift into the air and soar.
text.hungry: Look for berries on the ground.
text.no_food: No food nearby. Try by the shore.
text.chased: A predator! Fly up or run away.
text.about_looks: A large gull with a pale grey back and white belly. Its wings have black tips with white spots, its legs are pink and its yellow bill has a red spot.
text.about_food: It eats fish and crabs at the shore, and insects and berries inland.
text.about_home: It lives by the sea and by lakes. It nests in big groups near water and rests on flat ground and on rocks.
text.about_winter: Most fly south for the winter and come back in spring.
text.about_young: Chicks are born in spring. They stay close to the soft nest.
text.about_fact: It can float on the water and soar high in the wind.
